description: This Java source file defines the ImageCache class, which manages in-memory caching of Bitmap images using LruCache. It includes methods for caching and retrieving images, as well as maintaining cache size and retention through a Fragment.

classes.name: ImageCache
classes.description: Manages bitmap caching with in-memory storage, including methods to add and retrieve images, and handles cache size calculations.

classes.name: RetainFragment
classes.description: A static inner class extending Fragment that retains an object over configuration changes, used here to hold an ImageCache instance.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a singleton instance of ImageCache associated with a FragmentManager.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the in-memory cache with a size based on a percentage of max memory.

methods.name: addBitmapToCache
methods.description: Adds a Bitmap to the memory cache with a unique key.

methods.name: getBitmapFromMemCache
methods.description: Retrieves a Bitmap from the memory cache based on a key.

methods.name: getBitmapSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of a Bitmap in bytes, using API level-specific methods.

methods.name: calculateMemCacheSize
methods.description: Determines cache size in kilobytes based on a percentage of available memory, with bounds validation.

methods.name: findOrCreateRetainFragment
methods.description: Locates an existing RetainFragment or creates and adds a new one to retain cache across configuration changes.
